matches.rationale: FastAPI endpoints with HTTPException are built in orderflow/api.py, and the CI workflow runs Python 3.11/3.12 with pytest.
Cursor-based pagination over keyset store queries plus REST endpoints with proper 404 handling demonstrate API design and pagination.
SQLite store with ON CONFLICT idempotent upserts and a dead_letters table is shown in orderflow/store.py.
pytest suite includes consumer tests with fakes and an API test walking cursor pagination pages.
Prometheus counters and a histogram were defined, with counters wired into the consumer.
A Dockerfile installs requirements and runs the FastAPI app with uvicorn.
GitHub Actions workflow runs pytest across a Python version matrix on push and pull request.
No ledger evidence of stakeholder communication.
